heard: He quizzed me on underground rap, wearing a jacket I sold him. Name three unreleased songs, or you're a larper. So I name four, with the leaked dates, before he blinks. Okay, but that fit is probably raps. It's retail, I keep receipts like a tax office. This jacket is real archive, you wouldn't know. Except I know that jacket, it lived on my chair. I listed it last month, mall brand, worn twice, $40. He offered $4 first, then paid the full $40. I tell him, that's not archive, that's my chair. Cool, would you do $30 for the boots? Back home, I snapped the chair, listed, pile go, puts the whole chair live on five apps, so $30 for the boots, accept, counter, or block.
